newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait students burn Israeli flag, MPs slam Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait students burn Israeli flag, MPs slam Arafat.

text.p: About 150 Kuwait University students burned Israeli flags in a rally on Wednesday and an Islamist MP called Palestinian President Yasser Arafat a "dog" protecting the Jewish state.

"The uprising should not only be against Israel, (but also) against Yasser Arafat. This lowly man...He and his group became dogs protecting the Zionist entity," Shi'ite Islamist deputy Adnan Abul-Samad told the gathering.
The rally was called by the National Union of Kuwait Students, which is widely believed to be dominated by Islamists, to protest against Israel's settlement policy.
Students burned two Israeli flags at a Kuwait University site to express their anger over Israel's starting work on a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem last week.
"This is a message to the traitorous leader and big (Israel) agent (Arafat)," said Islamist deputy Nasser al-Sanea, chairman of parliament's economic committee.
Kuwait has condemned he Israeli move and said it jeopardises peace effort in the region.

A statement by the union called for "an immediate stoppage of the surrendering process" and said those concerned should start "addressing Jews with the language they understand, the language of Jihad (holy struggle)".
